skill.summary: Search the web using a self-hosted SearXNG instance. Privacy-respecting metasearch that aggregates results from multiple engines.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Privacy-respecting metasearch aggregating 70+ engines including Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Startpage, Yahoo, and more. Self-hosted via Docker with JSON API support for Clawdbot integration.
